truth_evidence: Affected 2019.03.09 to 2026.07.22. The vulnerability is a distrusted root CA bundled in the certificate data, not a defect in Python code.

Fix commit 5cb238c 'Remove emsign (#437)' removes the emSign root certificates from certifi/cacert.pem; the only other change is the version string. https://github.com/certifi/python-certifi/commit/5cb238caeeb6c30ec1a7309ad3e16a5aa7b10ce8
The fix commit also bumps __version__ in certifi/__init__.py. That is a module-level change to a .py file and must not be reported as vulnerable code.
No vulnerable function and no entry point exist; reachability is not a meaningful question for this advisory (every TLS verification using certifi.where() uses the bundle).
notes: No CVE alias at the time of writing; the advisory links no commit. The fix commit was found from tag 2026.10.18.
